title: Part 5 - Incomplete Sentence 001
knowledge: Từ loại: Danh từ đứng sau mạo từ

question.question_text: The company needs to hire an additional _____ to manage its growing customer base.
question.knowledge: Danh từ đứng sau mạo từ
question.explanation: After 'an additional', a singular countable noun is needed. 'Manager' fits the sentence.

title: Part 5 - Incomplete Sentence 002
knowledge: Từ loại: Tính từ đứng trước danh từ

question.question_text: The marketing team developed a _____ strategy to increase online sales.
question.knowledge: Tính từ đứng trước danh từ
question.explanation: A noun is needed after the article and before 'strategy'. 'Successful' is the correct adjective.

title: Part 5 - Incomplete Sentence 003
knowledge: Từ loại: Trạng từ bổ nghĩa cho động từ

question.question_text: The technician repaired the machine _____ and returned it to the production line.
question.knowledge: Trạng từ bổ nghĩa cho động từ
question.explanation: The adverb 'carefully' modifies the verb 'repaired'.

title: Part 5 - Incomplete Sentence 004
knowledge: Từ loại: Danh từ đứng sau tính từ sở hữu

question.question_text: The director praised the employees for their _____ to the project.
question.knowledge: Danh từ đứng sau từ hạn định sở hữu
question.explanation: After 'their', a noun is required. 'Dedication' is the correct noun.

title: Part 5 - Incomplete Sentence 005
knowledge: Từ loại: Tính từ đứng sau động từ liên kết (linking verb)

question.question_text: The new software system is extremely _____ to use.
question.knowledge: Tính từ đứng sau động từ liên kết (linking verb)
question.explanation: The linking verb 'is' is followed by an adjective. 'Convenient' is correct.

title: Part 5 - Incomplete Sentence 006
knowledge: Từ loại: Trạng từ đứng trước tính từ

question.question_text: The instructions were _____ clear to all participants.
question.knowledge: Trạng từ bổ nghĩa cho tính từ
question.explanation: The adverb 'completely' modifies the adjective 'clear'.

title: Part 5 - Incomplete Sentence 007
knowledge: Từ loại: Danh từ làm chủ ngữ

question.question_text: _____ of the new policy will begin next Monday.
question.knowledge: Danh từ làm chủ ngữ
question.explanation: A noun is needed as the subject of the sentence. 'Implementation' is correct.

title: Part 5 - Incomplete Sentence 008
knowledge: Từ loại: Tính từ đứng sau động từ to be

question.question_text: The documents submitted by the applicant were _____.
question.knowledge: Tính từ làm bổ ngữ cho chủ ngữ
question.explanation: After 'were', an adjective is needed to describe the documents. 'Accurate' is correct.

title: Part 5 - Incomplete Sentence 009
knowledge: Từ loại: Danh từ đứng sau giới từ

question.question_text: The manager is responsible for the _____ of all company records.
question.knowledge: Danh từ đứng sau giới từ
question.explanation: After 'for the', a noun is needed. 'Maintenance' fits the sentence.

title: Part 5 - Incomplete Sentence 010
knowledge: Từ loại: Trạng từ bổ nghĩa cho tính từ

question.question_text: The new policy is _____ different from the previous one.
question.knowledge: Trạng từ bổ nghĩa cho tính từ
question.explanation: The adverb 'significantly' modifies the adjective 'different'.

title: Part 5 - Incomplete Sentence 011
knowledge: Sự hòa hợp giữa chủ ngữ và động từ

question.question_text: The list of available products _____ updated every Friday.
question.knowledge: Chủ ngữ số ít đi kèm cụm giới từ
question.explanation: The main subject is singular 'list', so the singular verb 'is' is required.

title: Part 5 - Incomplete Sentence 012
knowledge: Sự hòa hợp giữa chủ ngữ và động từ

question.question_text: The employees in the accounting department _____ required to attend the meeting.
question.knowledge: Chủ ngữ số nhiều
question.explanation: The subject 'employees' is plural, so 'are' is correct.

title: Part 5 - Incomplete Sentence 013
knowledge: Sự hòa hợp giữa chủ ngữ và động từ

question.question_text: Each of the applicants _____ required to submit two references.
question.knowledge: Each + động từ số ít
question.explanation: 'Each' takes a singular verb, so 'is' is correct.

title: Part 5 - Incomplete Sentence 014
knowledge: Sự hòa hợp giữa chủ ngữ và động từ

question.question_text: Neither the manager nor the assistants _____ available this afternoon.
question.knowledge: Sự hòa hợp với cấu trúc Neither...nor
question.explanation: With 'neither...nor', the verb agrees with the nearer subject, 'assistants', which is plural.

title: Part 5 - Incomplete Sentence 015
knowledge: Sự hòa hợp giữa chủ ngữ và động từ

question.question_text: The information about the new products _____ available on the website.
question.knowledge: Danh từ không đếm được
question.explanation: 'Information' is uncountable and takes a singular verb.

title: Part 5 - Incomplete Sentence 016
knowledge: Sự hòa hợp giữa chủ ngữ và động từ

question.question_text: A number of customers _____ complained about the delayed delivery.
question.knowledge: A number of + danh từ số nhiều
question.explanation: 'A number of' is followed by a plural noun and plural verb.

title: Part 5 - Incomplete Sentence 017
knowledge: Sự hòa hợp giữa chủ ngữ và động từ

question.question_text: The number of online orders _____ increased significantly this month.
question.knowledge: The number of + danh từ số nhiều
question.explanation: 'The number' is singular, so 'has' is correct.

title: Part 5 - Incomplete Sentence 018
knowledge: Sự hòa hợp giữa chủ ngữ và động từ

question.question_text: Every employee _____ a company identification card.
question.knowledge: Every + danh từ số ít
question.explanation: 'Every employee' is singular, so 'has' is correct.

title: Part 5 - Incomplete Sentence 019
knowledge: Sự hòa hợp giữa chủ ngữ và động từ

question.question_text: The equipment in the training room _____ regularly inspected.
question.knowledge: Danh từ không đếm được
question.explanation: 'Equipment' is uncountable and takes a singular verb.

title: Part 5 - Incomplete Sentence 020
knowledge: Sự hòa hợp giữa chủ ngữ và động từ

question.question_text: The sales manager, along with two assistants, _____ attending the conference.
question.knowledge: Chủ ngữ chính đi kèm cụm từ chen giữa
question.explanation: The main subject is singular 'manager'; 'along with' does not change the number of the subject.

question.question_text: The company _____ three new branches since January.
question.knowledge: Thì hiện tại hoàn thành đi với 'since'
question.explanation: 'Since January' indicates an action continuing from the past to the present, so present perfect is needed.

question.question_text: The manager _____ the report yesterday afternoon.
question.knowledge: Thì quá khứ đơn với mốc thời gian đã kết thúc
question.explanation: 'Yesterday afternoon' refers to a finished past time, so the past simple is correct.

question.question_text: The new employees _____ their orientation session next Monday.
question.knowledge: Thì tương lai với một sự kiện đã được lên lịch
question.explanation: 'Next Monday' refers to the future, so 'will attend' is appropriate.

question.question_text: The accounting department _____ the annual budget this week.
question.knowledge: Thì hiện tại tiếp diễn diễn tả hành động tạm thời ở hiện tại
question.explanation: 'This week' describes an activity in progress around the present time.

question.question_text: By the time the meeting started, the director _____ the proposal.
question.knowledge: Thì quá khứ hoàn thành xảy ra trước một sự kiện quá khứ khác
question.explanation: The review happened before the meeting started, so past perfect is required.

title: Part 5 - Incomplete Sentence 026
knowledge: Thì: Hiện tại hoàn thành tiếp diễn

question.question_text: The engineers _____ on the project for six months.
question.knowledge: Thì hiện tại hoàn thành tiếp diễn đi với 'for'
question.explanation: 'For six months' describes an activity that began in the past and continues now.

question.question_text: While the assistant _____ the documents, the phone rang.
question.knowledge: Thì quá khứ tiếp diễn diễn tả hành động đang xảy ra thì bị xen vào
question.explanation: The longer action was in progress when the phone rang, so past continuous is correct.

question.question_text: By the end of this year, the company _____ its new headquarters.
question.knowledge: Thì tương lai hoàn thành đi với cấu trúc by + mốc thời gian trong tương lai
question.explanation: 'By the end of this year' indicates an action completed before a future deadline.

question.question_text: The store _____ at 9:00 a.m. every weekday.
question.knowledge: Thì hiện tại đơn diễn tả lịch trình thường xuyên
question.explanation: A regular schedule is expressed with the present simple.

question.question_text: The train had already left when we _____ at the station.
question.knowledge: Thì quá khứ đơn đứng sau 'when' trong chuỗi hành động quá khứ
question.explanation: The arrival happened after the train left, so the past simple 'arrived' is correct.

question.question_text: The conference will begin _____ 9:30 a.m.
question.knowledge: Giới từ dùng với mốc giờ cụ thể
question.explanation: Use 'at' with a specific clock time.

question.question_text: The office will be closed _____ Monday.
question.knowledge: Giới từ dùng với thứ/ngày
question.explanation: Use 'on' with days and dates.

question.question_text: The company was founded _____ 1998.
question.knowledge: Giới từ dùng với năm
question.explanation: Use 'in' with years and months.

question.question_text: The manager has worked here _____ ten years.
question.knowledge: For + khoảng thời gian
question.explanation: 'For' is used with a period of duration.

title: Part 5 - Incomplete Sentence 035
knowledge: Giới từ: Mốc thời gian bắt đầu

question.question_text: Ms. Lee has been the department head _____ 2022.
question.knowledge: Since + mốc thời gian bắt đầu
question.explanation: 'Since' is used with a specific starting point.

question.question_text: The meeting will take place _____ the main conference room.
question.knowledge: Giới từ chỉ vị trí trong một không gian khép kín
question.explanation: Use 'in' for an enclosed room or area.

question.question_text: Please send the completed form _____ the human resources department.
question.knowledge: Giới từ chỉ điểm đến
question.explanation: 'To' indicates the destination or recipient.

question.question_text: The flight was delayed _____ heavy rain.
question.knowledge: Because of + danh từ/cụm danh từ
question.explanation: 'Because of' is followed by a noun phrase such as 'heavy rain'.

question.question_text: The new software was developed _____ an experienced engineering team.
question.knowledge: By + tác nhân trong câu bị động
question.explanation: In passive voice, 'by' introduces the person or group performing the action.

question.question_text: The company purchased new computers _____ the design department.
question.knowledge: For + mục đích sử dụng hoặc đối tượng nhận
question.explanation: 'For' indicates the intended department or purpose.

question.question_text: _____ the product is expensive, many customers consider it a good investment.
question.knowledge: Although + mệnh đề
question.explanation: 'Although' introduces a contrasting clause.

question.question_text: The meeting was postponed _____ the manager was ill.
question.knowledge: Because + mệnh đề
question.explanation: 'Because' is followed by a complete clause.

question.question_text: _____ you submit the form today, your application can be processed tomorrow.
question.knowledge: If + điều kiện
question.explanation: 'If' introduces the condition necessary for the result.

question.question_text: Please wait here _____ the technician arrives.
question.knowledge: Until + mệnh đề chỉ thời gian
question.explanation: 'Until' means up to the time when the technician arrives.

question.question_text: The hotel offers free breakfast _____ complimentary airport transportation.
question.knowledge: And dùng để bổ sung thông tin
question.explanation: 'And' connects two similar services.

title: Part 5 - Incomplete Sentence 046
knowledge: Liên từ: Lựa chọn thay thế

question.question_text: You can pay by credit card _____ by bank transfer.
question.knowledge: Or dùng cho các lựa chọn thay thế
question.explanation: 'Or' presents alternative payment methods.

question.question_text: The road was closed, _____ the delivery arrived late.
question.knowledge: So dùng để chỉ kết quả
question.explanation: 'So' connects the cause with its result.

question.question_text: The restaurant was crowded, _____ we found a table quickly.
question.knowledge: But dùng để chỉ sự tương phản
question.explanation: 'But' introduces a contrasting result.

question.question_text: The order will not be shipped _____ payment is confirmed.
question.knowledge: Unless + điều kiện phủ định
question.explanation: 'Unless' means 'if not' and expresses the condition for shipping.

title: Part 5 - Incomplete Sentence 050
knowledge: Liên từ: Hành động diễn ra đồng thời

question.question_text: The receptionist answered calls _____ checking the appointment schedule.
question.knowledge: While + hoạt động diễn ra đồng thời
question.explanation: 'While' can introduce an activity happening at the same time.

question.question_text: The employee _____ prepared the report received an award.
question.knowledge: Who dùng cho người
question.explanation: 'Who' is used as a relative pronoun for people.

question.question_text: The software _____ we purchased last month has improved productivity.
question.knowledge: Which dùng cho vật
question.explanation: 'Which' is used to refer to a thing or product.

question.question_text: The office _____ the interview will be held is on the third floor.
question.knowledge: Where dùng cho nơi chốn
question.explanation: 'Where' refers to a place.

question.question_text: I remember the day _____ we opened the new branch.
question.knowledge: When dùng cho thời gian
question.explanation: 'When' refers to a time or day.

question.question_text: The applicant _____ resume was selected will be contacted today.
question.knowledge: Whose chỉ sự sở hữu
question.explanation: 'Whose' indicates possession: the resume belongs to the applicant.

question.question_text: The machine _____ was installed yesterday is already operating.
question.knowledge: Which làm chủ ngữ trong mệnh đề quan hệ
question.explanation: 'Which' is used for a machine and acts as the subject of the relative clause.

question.question_text: The consultant _____ we hired has extensive experience.
question.knowledge: Whom làm tân ngữ trong mệnh đề quan hệ
question.explanation: 'Whom' can be used as the object of 'hired' when referring to a person.

question.question_text: The documents _____ on the desk belong to the finance department.
question.knowledge: Rút gọn mệnh đề quan hệ dạng quá khứ phân từ (bị động)
question.explanation: 'Placed on the desk' is a reduced passive relative clause.

question.question_text: The invoices _____ by the accounting department every Friday.
question.knowledge: Bị động ở thì hiện tại đơn
question.explanation: The invoices receive the action, so passive voice is required. The regular schedule requires present simple.

question.question_text: The new policy _____ to all employees last week.
question.knowledge: Bị động ở thì quá khứ đơn
question.explanation: 'Last week' requires past simple, and the policy receives the action.

question.question_text: The equipment _____ before it was delivered to the customer.
question.knowledge: Bị động ở thì quá khứ hoàn thành
question.explanation: The inspection occurred before another past event, so past perfect passive is appropriate.

question.question_text: All applications must _____ by Friday.
question.knowledge: Động từ khuyết thiếu + be + quá khứ phân từ
question.explanation: After a modal, passive voice uses 'be + past participle'.

question.question_text: The meeting room is _____ every morning.
question.knowledge: Bị động ở thì hiện tại đơn
question.explanation: The room receives the action, so 'is cleaned' is correct.

question.question_text: The contract will _____ tomorrow.
question.knowledge: Bị động ở thì tương lai
question.explanation: After 'will', passive voice is formed with 'be + past participle'.

question.question_text: The damaged products _____ to the supplier for inspection.
question.knowledge: Bị động ở thì quá khứ đơn
question.explanation: The products received the action in the past, so 'were returned' is correct.

question.question_text: A final decision has _____ by the board.
question.knowledge: Bị động ở thì hiện tại hoàn thành
question.explanation: Present perfect passive uses 'has/have been + past participle'.

question.question_text: The manager asked the assistant _____ the documents immediately.
question.knowledge: Cấu trúc Ask + tân ngữ + to-infinitive
question.explanation: 'Ask someone to do something' requires a to-infinitive.

question.question_text: The company plans _____ a new branch next year.
question.knowledge: Cấu trúc Plan + to-infinitive
question.explanation: 'Plan' is followed by a to-infinitive.

question.question_text: The employees enjoy _____ in the new training program.
question.knowledge: Cấu trúc Enjoy + danh động từ
question.explanation: 'Enjoy' is followed by a gerund (-ing form).

question.question_text: Please avoid _____ confidential information in public areas.
question.knowledge: Cấu trúc Avoid + danh động từ
question.explanation: 'Avoid' is followed by a gerund.

question.question_text: The supervisor reminded everyone _____ their identification badges.
question.knowledge: Cấu trúc Remind + tân ngữ + to-infinitive
question.explanation: 'Remind someone to do something' requires a to-infinitive.

question.question_text: We are interested in _____ our services to international clients.
question.knowledge: Giới từ + danh động từ
question.explanation: After the preposition 'in', a gerund is required.

question.question_text: The customer called to _____ about the delayed shipment.
question.knowledge: To-infinitive chỉ mục đích
question.explanation: 'To complain' expresses the purpose of the call.

question.question_text: _____ regular backups can prevent data loss.
question.knowledge: Danh động từ làm chủ ngữ trong câu
question.explanation: 'Making regular backups' functions as the subject of the sentence.

question.question_text: Employees _____ wear their identification badges while on company premises.
question.knowledge: Must chỉ sự bắt buộc
question.explanation: 'Must' expresses a strong requirement or obligation.

question.question_text: You _____ contact the supplier if the shipment does not arrive today.
question.knowledge: Should dùng để đưa ra lời khuyên
question.explanation: 'Should' is used to give advice or a recommendation.

question.question_text: The package _____ arrive by noon if there are no delays.
question.knowledge: May chỉ khả năng có thể xảy ra
question.explanation: 'May' expresses possibility.

question.question_text: Visitors _____ enter the laboratory without permission.
question.knowledge: Must not chỉ sự cấm đoán
question.explanation: 'Must not' expresses prohibition.

question.question_text: The manager _____ be in her office; her car is outside.
question.knowledge: Might chỉ khả năng xảy ra
question.explanation: 'Might' indicates a possible situation based on evidence.

question.question_text: All employees _____ submit their expense reports by Friday.
question.knowledge: Have to chỉ nghĩa vụ/sự bắt buộc
question.explanation: 'Have to' expresses an external requirement or obligation.

question.question_text: _____ you please send me the updated schedule?
question.knowledge: Could dùng cho yêu cầu lịch sự
question.explanation: 'Could you please...' is a common polite request.

question.question_text: This year's sales figures are _____ than last year's.
question.knowledge: Tính từ so sánh hơn
question.explanation: The phrase 'than last year's' requires a comparative adjective.

question.question_text: This is the _____ product in our current catalog.
question.knowledge: Tính từ so sánh nhất
question.explanation: 'The' plus a comparison among all products requires the superlative form.

question.question_text: The new printer operates _____ than the old model.
question.knowledge: Trạng từ so sánh hơn
question.explanation: The verb 'operates' needs an adverb, and 'than' requires the comparative form.

title: Part 5 - Incomplete Sentence 085
knowledge: Cấu trúc so sánh bằng As...as

question.question_text: The new office is not _____ large as the previous one.
question.knowledge: Cấu trúc As + tính từ + as
question.explanation: The standard comparison is 'not as + adjective + as'.

question.question_text: The updated software is _____ reliable than the previous version.
question.knowledge: Tính từ so sánh hơn đi với than
question.explanation: 'More reliable than' is the correct comparative structure.

question.question_text: Ms. Brown is _____ experienced manager with over ten years in the industry.
question.knowledge: Mạo từ không xác định đứng trước từ bắt đầu bằng nguyên âm
question.explanation: 'Experienced' begins with a vowel sound, so 'an' is required.

question.question_text: Please send the invoice to _____ customer listed on the order form.
question.knowledge: Mạo từ xác định dùng cho danh từ cụ thể
question.explanation: The customer is specific and identified by the order form, so 'the' is correct.

question.question_text: We need to purchase _____ new printer for the office.
question.knowledge: Mạo từ không xác định dùng cho một đối tượng chung chung
question.explanation: 'Printer' is a singular countable noun introduced for the first time, so 'a' is correct.

question.question_text: The company provides _____ information about its products on its website.
question.knowledge: Không dùng mạo từ với danh từ không đếm được mang nghĩa chung
question.explanation: 'Information' is uncountable and is used generally here, so no article is needed.

question.question_text: The manager asked Sarah and _____ to prepare the presentation.
question.knowledge: Đại từ làm tân ngữ
question.explanation: The pronoun is the object of 'asked', so the object form 'me' is correct.

question.question_text: The company introduced a new policy to ensure that all employees protect _____.
question.knowledge: Đại từ phản thân
question.explanation: The plural subject 'all employees' requires the reflexive pronoun 'themselves'.

question.question_text: The marketing department presented _____ proposal to the director.
question.knowledge: Tính từ sở hữu
question.explanation: 'Department' is singular, so the possessive adjective 'its' is required.

question.question_text: The two managers agreed that the final decision should be _____.
question.knowledge: Đại từ sở hữu
question.explanation: 'Theirs' is a possessive pronoun and can stand alone after 'be'.

question.question_text: If the weather improves, the outdoor event _____ as planned.
question.knowledge: Câu điều kiện loại 1
question.explanation: In the first conditional, the if-clause uses present simple and the result uses 'will + verb'.

question.question_text: If I _____ more time, I would review the entire report.
question.knowledge: Câu điều kiện loại 2
question.explanation: The second conditional uses past simple in the if-clause and 'would' in the result clause.

question.question_text: If the technician had arrived earlier, we _____ the problem sooner.
question.knowledge: Câu điều kiện loại 3
question.explanation: The third conditional describes an unreal past condition and uses 'would have + past participle'.

question.question_text: Unless the payment _____ received today, the order will be canceled.
question.knowledge: Câu điều kiện loại 1 với 'unless'
question.explanation: After 'unless', use the present simple for a real future condition. Passive form is 'is received'.

title: Part 5 - Incomplete Sentence 099
knowledge: Danh từ đếm được / không đếm được

question.question_text: The company received several _____ from customers about the service.
question.knowledge: Danh từ đếm được số nhiều
question.explanation: 'Several' must be followed by a plural countable noun.

title: Part 5 - Incomplete Sentence 100
knowledge: Danh từ đếm được / không đếm được

question.question_text: We need some _____ before making a final decision.
question.knowledge: Danh từ không đếm được
question.explanation: 'Advice' is uncountable and does not take a plural '-s'.
